BEGIN;

LOCK TABLE teacher_onboarding_interaction IN ACCESS EXCLUSIVE MODE;
LOCK TABLE teacher_onboarding_terminal_session IN ACCESS EXCLUSIVE MODE;

DO $$
BEGIN
    IF EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM teacher_onboarding_interaction
        WHERE session_schema_version IS NOT NULL
    ) THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'cannot roll back migration 023: stamped onboarding session evidence is retained permanently';
    END IF;
    IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM teacher_onboarding_terminal_session) THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'cannot roll back migration 023: terminal onboarding session evidence is retained permanently';
    END IF;
END $$;

DROP TRIGGER trg_protect_teacher_onboarding_terminal_session_truncate ON teacher_onboarding_terminal_session;
DROP TRIGGER trg_protect_teacher_onboarding_terminal_session_delete ON teacher_onboarding_terminal_session;
DROP TRIGGER trg_protect_teacher_onboarding_terminal_session ON teacher_onboarding_terminal_session;
DROP FUNCTION protect_teacher_onboarding_terminal_session_delete();
DROP FUNCTION protect_teacher_onboarding_terminal_session();
DROP TABLE teacher_onboarding_terminal_session;

DROP TRIGGER trg_protect_teacher_onboarding_session_schema_version ON teacher_onboarding_interaction;
DROP FUNCTION protect_teacher_onboarding_session_schema_version();
ALTER TABLE teacher_onboarding_interaction
    DROP CONSTRAINT teacher_onboarding_interaction_session_admission_ck,
    DROP CONSTRAINT teacher_onboarding_interaction_session_schema_version_ck,
    DROP COLUMN session_schema_version;

COMMIT;
